messages:
leo: Heads-up — planning an unpin of runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 in staging tonight 23:00 PT. Need to lock fallback routing + concrete rollback criteria before the window. cc @sre @runtime

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: https://rt.redwood.example/tickets/INC-8721. Window: 23:00-01:00 PT. Notifying oncall. :calendar:

sahil: Quick q: do older SDK clients (1.4.x) gracefully fall back to runtime v2.14 ABI? We still have ~4% of traffic on that SDK in staging sim runs.

ida: Short answer: runtime v2.15 changes the KV-cache key encoding (minor ABI delta). SDK 1.4 will hit an edge-case where prefix lookup returns miss, but should not crash. We should gate customer-facing staging canaries until a shim is in place or fallback routing engaged.

maria: Proposed fallback policy (for staging): route to runtime-2.14-compat when either error-rate > 1.5% OR 95th latency > 400ms sustained for 3m. Canary rollout: 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with a 15m observation at each step. If ANY step hits fallback, stop rollout and rollback to previous runtime for canary cohort.

ajay: +1. Suggest interleaved unpin across regions (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1) to avoid correlated noise. Also add a perf smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -H 'x-test:perf'` and assert median latency < 220ms and token throughput <= baseline*1.2.

leo: Can we make the fallback plumbed into deploybot so ops can flip without code change? Something like: `deploybot set-fallback --from=runtime-2.15 --to=runtime-2.14 --err-ps=1.5 --latency-ms=400 --sustain=3m`

deploy-bot: Command registered. To activate during rollout run: `/deploybot activate-fallback INC-8721` (requires approver with :shield: role).

sahil: If we do that, also add a metric to log when SDK 1.4 hits miss vs success, so we can quantify impact.

ida: Will add `sdk_client.version` tag to the trace and a lightweight eval that replays failed prefix lookups. Adding to the preflight checklist now.

maria: Rollback criteria (final draft): 1) error-rate delta >= +1.5% absolute sustained over 3m, 2) 95th latency increase >= +250ms vs baseline sustained 3m, 3) correctness regressions on smoke prompts > 0.8% (as measured by eval harness). Any one triggers immediate fallback activation and pause of rollout.

ajay: I'll orchestrate the interleaved cohorts and update the region map in infra. Plan to start 23:05 PT, first canary 3% in us-west1.

leo: Nice. @maria @ida please post the preflight checklist and deploybot activation steps in INC-8721 before 18:00 PT. I'll be oncall for the window. :white_check_mark:

maria: Will do. posting checklist now. :eyes:

ida: Preflight note added: run `python infra/tools/smoke.py --runtime 2.15 --profile staging` and check `logs/smoke-*.json` for kv-prefetch misses.

leo: SGTM, thanks everyone.
